import numpy as np, pandas as pd

# Assemble dataset
hist = archivo.copy()
hist["T"] = 1.0
hist["source"] = "archivo"
hist = hist[["y","T","source"]]

mon = monitoreo.copy()
if "T" not in mon.columns:
    mon["T"] = 1.0
mon["source"] = "monitoreo"
mon = mon[["y","T","source"]]

exp_rows = []
for T, df in exp_data.items():
    tmp = df.copy()
    tmp["source"] = f"exp_{T}"
    exp_rows.append(tmp[["y","T","source"]]])
exp_all = pd.concat(exp_rows, ignore_index=True)

all_df = pd.concat([hist, mon, exp_all], ignore_index=True)

print("Combined shape:", all_df.shape)
print(all_df.groupby("T")["y"].agg(["count","mean","std"]))

# Quadratic mean fit
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(all_df)), all_df["T"].to_numpy(), all_df["T"].to_numpy()**2])
y = all_df["y"].to_numpy()
beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)[0]
mu_hat = X @ beta
resid = y - mu_hat

# Heteroskedastic variance: fit log(resid^2 + eps) ~ 1 + T
eps = 1e-6
Z = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(all_df)), all_df["T"].to_numpy()])
gamma = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, np.log(resid**2 + eps), rcond=None)[0]
sigma_hat = np.sqrt(np.exp(Z @ gamma))

# Standardized residual tail check for t df candidates
std_res = resid / sigma_hat
for df_t in [3,4,5,6,8,12,20,1000]:
    if df_t == 1000:
        # approx normal excess kurtosis ~0
        theo_exkurt = 0.0
    elif df_t > 4:
        theo_exkurt = 6/(df_t-4)
    else:
        theo_exkurt = np.inf
    print("candidate_df", df_t, "theoretical_excess_kurtosis", theo_exkurt)
print("\nResidual summary:")
print(pd.Series(std_res).describe(percentiles=[0.01,0.05,0.1,0.9,0.95,0.99]))
print("sample excess kurtosis:", float(pd.Series(std_res).kurt()))
print("\nbeta:", beta)
print("gamma:", gamma)
print("Budget remaining:", env.describe()["budget_remaining"])
